# `usize-in-packed-struct`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports pointer-sized integer fields in packed or extern layouts.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`usize` and `isize` change width by target, making serialized, ABI, or hardware
layouts unstable.

## When it fires

It applies to fields whose containing layout is explicitly packed or extern.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Header = packed struct {
    flags: u32,
    count: usize,
};
```
